column1: # Norwegian Bokmål glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, not judged by the council, not reviewed by a native speaker; nothing here is final.

# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Norwegian, forms separated by " | ", canonical form first. Matching is by whole words. Only the lock terms also match the start of a compound (lexicon.COMPOUNDING), so list other compounds here or write them apart. Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them.

# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo stay until D3 flips them to dnt. D3's new rows (and renamed ids) wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/nb.tsv.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Toppfart and the measured value Maksimal fart, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3, except rides_tile_max_speed: it is measured, so translate it Toppfart now; no hold is needed because D3 agrees.
